# BHRIGU

BHRIGU is the public home for working services, research surfaces, and products.

## Current public structure
- BTC Cosmographer / BTC Field: the current primary public product axis for evidence-linked Bitcoin intelligence.
- Frey: an active and distinct temporal reading and dialogue service.
- Cosmographer: a broader interpretation and navigation role; BTC Cosmographer is its Bitcoin-specific public application.
- ORION: protected research depth, not a public API and not automatic product authority.

Bitcoin-first does not mean Bitcoin-only. Existing BHRIGU portal surfaces remain valid public routes unless explicitly retired.

## Canonical public pages
- https://www.bhrigu.io/
- https://www.bhrigu.io/frey
- https://www.bhrigu.io/cosmographer
- https://www.bhrigu.io/map
- https://www.bhrigu.io/crypto-astro/btc?lang=en
- https://www.bhrigu.io/crypto-astro/btc?lang=ru
- https://www.bhrigu.io/support

## Current BTC dialogue
- https://www.bhrigu.io/crypto-astro/btc/clean-chat?lang=en
- https://www.bhrigu.io/crypto-astro/btc/clean-chat?lang=ru

The Clean Chat dialogue is session-local and noindex. It is not a canonical knowledge page.
The older /crypto-astro/btc/live route remains a bounded legacy/public evidence route and is not the preferred dialogue entry.

## Index policy
The BHRIGU home, Frey, Cosmographer, Map, Support, and BTC entry pages are public surfaces.
The BTC entry page and its accepted public knowledge are indexable.
Session-specific or arbitrary dialogue pages are noindex and should not be treated as durable published knowledge.

## Evidence boundary
Market answers use accepted market evidence and explicit freshness boundaries.
Bitcoin protocol answers use pinned protocol sources.
Astronomical answers use published or explicitly authorized ephemeris evidence.
Astronomy × BTC comparisons do not claim causality.
BHRIGU does not provide guaranteed prices, trading instructions, leverage instructions, or position sizing.

## Protected research boundary
X4, private ORION internals, the Cosmography Dynamical Engine, and unpublished research assets are not public product claims merely because they exist in the broader research system.
